title: Dynamic Island
enabled.label: Show Dynamic Island
enabled.sublabel: A lyric capsule with artwork at the top of the screen. Drag it anywhere and release near the top edge to snap back.
transition.label: Line transition
scale.label: Size
showTranslation.label: Show translation
snapCentered.label: Center when snapped
snapCentered.sublabel: When off, the island keeps the horizontal position you dragged it to.
nonOcclusive.label: Non-occlusive mode
nonOcclusive.sublabel: Clicks pass through and the island fades out on hover. It can't be dragged in this mode.
alwaysOnTop.label: Keep on top
